values.note: Otsego Police Department fee list: $30 a night for a cement (RV) site, $20 for a tent site (left out of the base). Paid at the Police Department, cash or check only.

fees.source: https://www.cityofotsego.org/otsego-police-department/ ('Camping $20.00 per night (tent site) $30.00 per night (cement site)'; 'The Police Department only accepts cash or check'; page (c) 2026), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://www.cityofotsego.org/city-parks/ ('overnight camping facilities for 4 recreational vehicles'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Not reservable; register at the Otsego Police Department, 127 Court St. (non-emergency line (269) 692-6111, office hours Mon-Thu 7-5; after hours calls go to Allegan County dispatch).

booking.source: https://www.cityofotsego.org/city-parks/ ('These facilities are not reserved and the camping sites are available for a maximum of three consecutive days. Registration is available at the Police Department') + https://www.cityofotsego.org/otsego-police-department/ (address, phone, office hours), read 2026-10-22

note: City of Otsego municipal campground at the back of Brookside Park off M-89 along the Kalamazoo River. RV sites have concrete pads; water comes from 2 spigots shared across 3 sites (bring a splitter); a couple of tent sites too. Register and pay in person at the Otsego Police Department (127 Court St). --Claude
summary: City pages (c) 2026: 4 RV sites, not reservable, 3 consecutive days max, register at the Police Department; $30/night cement site ($20 tent), cash or check. Confirmed booking (reservable false, FCFS, 3-night max); added fees and site count. Electric (30 A), water/sewer and facilities values not stated by the city; left as derived. Note cleaned of the site count, amperage, no-sewer/dump, FCFS, 3-night and price text.
